Upon selection of A-GRA, the Mission Planner Autonomy UI must dynamically reconfigure connection parameter fields (e.g., IPs, Ports, Serial) to match the A- GRA interface format and auto -populate with appropriate default values. The Government is in no way obligated to make an award, nor to pay any costs incurred by the Contractor in preparing and submitting its quote. 1.1 PURPOSE AND BACKGROUND This Statement of Work (SOW) establishes the requirements for the acquisition and deployment of Think Trends Software, an Agentic AI technology platform, to support FDA adverse event reporting workflows. Think Trends Software will be leveraged for its AI -powered Document Processing and Agentic Optical Character Recognition (OCR) capabilities to streamline adverse eve

erse experiences, product use patterns, health effects, consumer narratives, and product category information. D. Case Validation, Quality Control, and Human-in-the-Loop Review Think Trends Software shall incorporate validation agents to compare extracted data against business rules, required fields, confidence thresholds, terminology standards, and case -processing logic. Records that meet defined thresholds may proceed automatically, while exceptions shall be routed for human review. Key quality-control features include: • Confidence scoring at field, document, and case levels. • Source traceability to page, section, table, and line references. • Automated flagging of missing, inconsistent, conflicting, or low-confidence data. • Human-in-the-loop review screens for case processors and safety reviewers. • Reviewer acceptance, correction, override, and approval workflows. • Full audit trail of AI extraction, human edits, and final approved values. E. Data Standardization and Regulatory Output Generation Think Trends Software shall transform extracted adverse event information into structured formats required for case management, analytics, and downstream regulatory processing. The platform shall support configurable mappings to FDA data standards, Center-specific systems, XM

CVM, CDRH, CTP, and HFP to configure unique workflows, data models, rules, and outputs. 3. End -to-End Adverse Event Case Automation: Think Trends Software supports intake, classification, extraction, validation, triage, routing, human review, data transformation, and downstream submission/output generation. 4. Human-in-the-Loop Regulatory Control: The system keeps FDA reviewers in control by allowing them to review, correct, approve, or override AI-generated outputs before final case acceptance. 5. Explainability and Source Traceability: Each extracted field can be traced back to the original source document, page, section, and text reference, supporting transparency, auditability, and reviewer confidence. 6. Confidence-Based Processing: Think Trends Software assigns confidence scores to extracted data and automatically routes low-confidence or inconsistent records for human review. 7. Multi -Document and Multi -Format Processing: Think Trends Software shall process scanned PDFs, structured forms, unstructured narratives, tables, handwritten content where feasible, images, attachments, correspondence, and supporting records. 8. Duplicate and Follow -Up Detection: AI agents shall compare incoming submissions against existing records to identify potential duplicates, follow-

STATEMENT OF WORK C. 1. OVERVIEW/BACKGROUND. The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory

The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory of NLS DA2 devices. NLS requires quantities suffi

The contractor shall be responsible for providing RealSAM Dialog licenses and services required to operate the system in production, while meeting all IT information-system security requirements as required by the Library of Congress. C.2 BACKGROUND NLS administers a free program that loans audio and braille books and magazines, music scores in braille and large print, and specially designed audio-playback and refreshable-braille-display equipment to residents of the United States who are unable to read or use standard print materials due to visual or physical impairment. NLS administers the program nationally, while direct service to eligible individuals and institutions is the responsibility of cooperating network libraries in the various states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Guam, and the U. S. Virgin Islands. This service is also extended to eligible American citizens residing abroad. POLITIQUE SUR LA PRIORISATION DES FOURNISSEURS CANADIENS ET CONTENU CANADIEN Le présent appel d’offres est ouvert uniquement aux fournisseurs canadiens AUTORISATIONS DE TÂCHES L’ensemble du contrat subséquent sera un contrat à autorisation de tâches. Le contrat avec autorisations de tâches (AT) est une méthode d'approvisionnement de services selon laquelle l'ensemble ou une portion des travaux sont réalisés « selon la demande ». Dans le cadre de contrats avec AT, le travail à réaliser peut être défini, mais la nature et les échéances précises des services, des activités et des produits livrables requis ne sont connus qu'au moment où le service est demandé pendant la durée du contrat. L'AT est un outil administratif structuré grâce auquel la Couronne autorise un entrepreneur à effectuer les travaux « selon la demande », conformément aux modalités du contrat. Les AT ne sont pas des contrats individuels. PROGRAMME DES MARCHANDISES CONTRÔLÉES La présente demande d’offres est assujettie au Programme des marchandises contrôlées (PMC). La Loi sur la production de défense définit les marchandises canadiennes contrôlées comme certains biens énumérés dans la Liste des marchandises d’exportation contrôlée du Canada, un règlement adopté en v

e tout marché avec les fournisseurs. Les documents peuvent être présentés dans l’une ou l’autre des langues officielles du Canada. ************************** DESCRIPTION Public Works and Government Services Canada (PWGSC), on behalf of the Defence Research and Development Canada (DRDC) – Valcartier Research Centre (VRC), is issuing this Solicitation of Offers for the acquisition of specialized modelling, simulation and software development services in support of research, development, analysis and evaluation of military systems and capabilities at Defence Research and Development Canada(DRDC) – Valcartier Research Centre (VRC).
